messages.author: 1b3a7204419f6807
messages.subject: Cannot Update SQL data in MySql by actionButton()
parts:
Hi all :

  I am trying to construct a form in Shiny, to let my coworker maintains data in MySQL.

  My RMySQL works, I can use dbSendQuery(MySQLCon, Query),
  but if I want to use actionButton() to UPDATE information to database,
  It can't work, and it also shows no warning.


###### ###### ######
  ui.R:

# define UI
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  # I add some js and css here for login mechanism by https://gist.github.com/withr/9001831
  # so I should put observe() in observe() which for login
  # and it report error that I don't know why
  ## Login module;
  div(class = "login", uiOutput("uiLogin"), textOutput("pass")),

  title = "Shiny Demo",

  # mainPanel
  uiOutput("MainUI")
))

###### ###### ######
  server.R:

# Load Data loading R
# Link RMySQLLogin
source("./Data/RMySQLLogin.R",  local = TRUE)
DataInputNow = DataInput
DataUpdate = reactive({
  input$KeyInSend

  library(RMySQL)
  MySQLCon = dbConnect(MySQL(),
               host = "localhost",
               db = "DB",
               user = "Usr",
               password = "PW")
  DataTableName = "Data"
  DataInput = dbReadTable(MySQLCon, DataTableName)
  retune(isolate({DataInput}))
})
DataInputNow = DataUpdate()

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  # Authenticate
  observe({
    if (USER$Logged == TRUE) {
      # KeyIn UI
      source("./KeyIn/KeyIn.R",  local = TRUE, encodin = "utf-8")

      # main
      output$MainUI = renderUI({
        mainPanel(
          tabsetPanel(id = 'TabSet',
            tabPanel(title = "Key In Data",
              numericInput("KeyInChoice", "Choice Row You Want", value = 1,
                min = 1, max = dim(DataInputNow)[1], step = 1),
              uiOutput("KeyIn")),,
            tabPanel(title = "Raw Data",
              dataTableOutput("TableInput"))
          )
        )
      })

      output$TableInput = renderDataTable({
          #DataInput[, input$TableInputVarShow, drop = FALSE]
          DataInputNow 
        }, option = list(orderClasses = TRUE))

    } # else show nothing
  })
})

###### ###### ######
  KeyIn.R

output$ApplyKeyIn = renderUI({
  fluidPage(
    fluidRow(
      column(width = 3,
        # Subj ID
        textInput("IDSubj", "Subj ID",
            value = reactive({
                       if (is.null(input$KeyInChoice)) {
                       return("NULL")
                        } else {
                      return(isolate({ DataInputNow$IDSubj[input$KeyInChoice] })) }
                     })())
      ),
      column(width = 3,
        # Birthday
        dateInput("DayBir", "Birthday",
                    value = reactive({
                               if (is.null(input$KeyInChoice)) {
                       return("NULL")
                        } else {
                      return(isolate({ DataInputNow$DayBir[input$KeyInChoice] })) }
                             })(),
                    max = DateNow, format = "yyyy/mm/dd", language = "zh-TW")
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(width = 12,
        # Send
        actionButton("KeyInSend", "Send")
      )
    )
  )
})

# listening to edit data
KeyInUpdate = observe({
  if (input$KeyInSend == 0) {
    return()
  }

  input$KeyInSend

  isolate({
    IDSubj = input$IDSubj
    DayBir = input$DayBir
    UpdateMySQL(DataTableName, "DayBir", DayBir, IDSubj)
  })
})

###### ###### ######
  RMySQLLogin.R

library(RMySQL)

MySQLCon = dbConnect(MySQL(),
                 host = "localhost",
                 db = "DB",
                 user = "Usr",
                 password = "PW")
DataTableName = "Data"

DataInput = dbReadTable(MySQLCon, DataTableName)

# turn off connection
Allcons = dbListConnections(MySQL())
for (MySQLCon in Allcons) {
  dbDisconnect(MySQLCon)
}

UpdateMySQL = function(DataTableName, ColName, UpdateValue, UpdateIDSubj) {
  library(RMySQL)
  MySQLCon = dbConnect(MySQL(),
                   host = "localhost",
                   db = "DB",
                   user = "Usr",
                   password = "PW")
  Query = paste('UPDATE', DataTableName, ' ', # name of table in db
                  'SET', ColName, '="', UpdateValue, '" ', 
                  'WHERE IDSubj ="', UpdateIDSubj, '";', sep = "")
  fetch(dbSendQuery(MySQLCon, Query), n = -1)

  # turn off connection
  Allcons = dbListConnections(MySQL())
  for (MySQLCon in Allcons) {
    dbDisconnect(MySQLCon)
  }
}
###### ###### ######

  Thanks for reading my question : )

messages.subject: Re: Cannot Update SQL data in MySql by actionButton()
parts:
By the way, it looks to me like this code is quite susceptible to SQL injection attack. When pasting your queries together, you must use RMySql's dbEscapeStrings function to wrap user-inputted values.

Hadley Wickham is working on some improvements to the DBI family of packages that will make this much easier to do safely/correctly in the future.
